# RWANFTFI

> RWANFTFI is a Web3 protocol on BNB Smart Chain where NFT access tiers define eligibility for protocol features: the partner program, the FinPro financial products, DA mechanics, and governance. DA is a non-transferable BEP-20 protocol utility token with a maximum supply of 21,000,000 units, supported by a designated USDT liquidity pool. NFTM Mining, DA Farming, and DA Lending are documented mechanics scheduled for activation in 2027. Live ecosystem services include FinPro (FinFlow), the RWA NFT Cards Visa debit card, a cross-chain bridge, and an AML Checker. Smart contracts within the published scope were reviewed by CertiK and use the Diamond architecture (EIP-2535). Verified RWA integrations remain roadmap items until activated and documented.

Canonical site: https://rwanftfi.com

## Core concepts

- [Executive Summary](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/executive-summary): Overview of the RWANFTFI protocol — 10 NFT access tiers, the 21M-capped Deflationary Asset (DA), partner-network mechanics, live ecosystem services, and the CertiK review.
- [Vision & Problem Statement](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/vision): Why RWANFTFI exists — turning NFTs into membership-based access keys for a structured ecosystem with documented eligibility.
- [FAQ](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/faq): Answers about NFT tiers, the partner program, FinPro, ecosystem services, DA, security, governance, and legal terms.
- [Glossary](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/glossary): Definitions of protocol, partner-program, FinPro, and security terms — DA, NFTM, Protocol Reward Cap, Gift NFT, FinFlow, Earn cap, Secret Code, and others.

## NFT ecosystem

- [NFT Ecosystem](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/nft-ecosystem): All 10 NFT tiers (Genesis through Infinity) with access prices from 28 to 24,000 USDT, Protocol Reward Caps, Partner Network Depth, features by tier, FinFlow access, Gift NFTs, Vouchers, and planned Ambassador/VIP editions.
- [Frozen Balance](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/frozen-balance): The temporary 72-hour buffer for an eligible Sponsor Bonus that exceeds the holder's remaining Protocol Reward Cap.

## FinPro

- [FinPro & FinFlow](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/finpro-finflow): The FinPro line of financial products and FinFlow, live since 8 July 2026 — access, limits, position parameters, accruals, the 200% Earn cap, Refund, and FinFlow Promotion 2026.
- [FinPro Marketing](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/finpro-marketing): The separate partner program for FinPro products — Claim Spot pre-launch, structure, Direct Sale and 20 levels, limits, and rules.

## Ecosystem services

- [Debit Cards](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/debit-cards): RWA NFT Cards, an international dollar Visa debit card topped up with stablecoins — four Plans and where to get a card.
- [Cross-Chain Bridge](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/bridge): Deposits into the ecosystem from 14 networks through bridge.rwanftfi.com.
- [AML Checker](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/aml-checker): Wallet-address risk checks across 19 blockchains and 14 stablecoins, with packages and the check flow.
- [Platform Features](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/platform-features): Secret Code, Private Web3 chats on XMTP, the referral link format, the brandbook, and resources.

## Deflationary Asset (DA)

- [DA Token Mechanics](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/da-token-mechanics): The protocol price formula (designated USDT liquidity-pool balance ÷ circulating DA supply), liquidity sources, burn mechanisms, the biannual Deflationary Cycle, and Seed Supply.
- [Mining & Farming](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/da-mining-farming): Two-step process (Mining records NFTM, Farming calculates DA), cycle durations by tier (45–40 days), and the 72-hour claim window; activation scheduled for 2027.
- [Selling & Lending](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/da-selling-lending): Manual sale at the current 75% payout, Auto-Sell at 70% over four scheduled periods (120/90/90/65 days), and lending at the documented 70% LTV; activation scheduled for 2027.
- [Lending Against DA](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/da-lending): Loan parameters, the recorded loan price, partial repayment, default processing, and important lending conditions; activation scheduled for 2027.

## Marketing & rewards

- [Marketing Structure & Placement](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/marketing-binary-tree): Smart-contract-managed placement, the weakest-branch algorithm, spillover, Partner Network Depth, network capacity, and the referral link format.
- [Rewards & Compensation](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/marketing-rewards): Sponsor Bonus, Tree Distribution, Matching Bonus, the 75/20/5 standard split, compression, and active promotions.

## Architecture & security

- [Smart Contract Architecture](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/architecture): EIP-2535 Diamond architecture with eight functional facets, separate NFT and reserve contracts, upgradeability matrix, the DAO contract and roles, and the balance schema.
- [Contract Parameters](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/contract-parameters): Current on-chain values, permitted ranges, function status, immutable constants, and the parameter change log of executed DAO votes.
- [Security & Audit](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/security): CertiK review (final report dated 28 April 2026) and bug bounty, four layers of account security, account recovery via DAO, AML screening, private messaging, and the official domains.

## Governance

- [Governance — DAO](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/governance): Fixed-supply 10,000,000 ERC20Votes GovToken, 30% proposal threshold, 50% approval threshold, current allocation (Corporation 30% + 20 Guardians at 3.5%), executed decisions, and the documented future redistribution.

## Roadmap & resources

- [Roadmap](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/roadmap): Quarter-by-quarter milestones from Q2 2026 through 2028, with completed, in-progress, and planned items.
- [Corporate Structure](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/corporate-structure): RWANFTFI Corporation (Panama, technology) and NFT FI Corporation (BVI, commercial operations); public disclosure and the compliance framework.
- [Intellectual Property](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/intellectual-property): The RWANFT word mark, UKIPO case number UK00004369823, the live registry record, and the brandbook.
- [Legal & Compliance](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/legal): NFT Purchase and Use Agreement, digital-access-product description, FinPro positions, the debit card's own legal documents, eligibility, and user responsibility.
- [Partnerships](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/partnerships): Current integrations, partnership categories, and status definitions.
- [Support](https://whitepaper.rwanftfi.com/en/support): Official channels and security guidance.
